cards.name: hero
cards.question: Instagram Grid Maker
cards.qualifier: Upload one image, choose a grid size and tile shape, drag and zoom to frame it, and download numbered tiles that form one large picture across your Instagram profile.

cards.name: how-to
cards.title: How to make an Instagram grid

steps.title: Choose the grid and tile shape
steps.text: Pick the number of rows and the tile shape: 4:5, 3:4 or square.

cards.name: best-practices
cards.title: Getting a clean result on your profile

cards.name: key-point
cards.quote: The Instagram grid maker cuts one image into a set of tiles that, posted in the right order, rebuild the full picture on your Instagram profile.
